details.label: Alert detail
details.text:
A combination of light wind and clear skies has allowed for areas
of fog development early this morning. With temperatures hovering
at or just below freezing, bridges, overpasses, and other cold
surfaces could become slick due to freezing fog. Visibility may
drop to as low as a quarter mile at times, particularly in river
valleys and other low lying areas where the fog is the most dense.

Exercise caution during the morning commute. Slow down and leave
extra room between other vehicles, especially when encountering
reduced visibility and any slick surfaces.
